steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.

attacks.name: Brutal End
steps: |!wild| |*Stagger|: After this attack is resolved, the target character gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition.

superPowers.name: Black Fury
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature or an enemy character, both of |!size| 4 or less and within |!range| 2, and Throw it |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Enforced Oblivion
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character makes a Move action. The next attack it makes this activation adds 2 dice to its attack roll.

superPowers.name: Intimidating Presence
superPowers.body: When an enemy character within |!range| 2 of this character targets another allied character with an attack, this character may use this superpower. This character becomes the target of the attack regardless of range and LOS.

superPowers.name: Invulnerable Skin
superPowers.body: When this character would suffer |!damage| from an enemy effect, reduce the amount suffered by 1, to a minimum of 1.
